column1: ra-PreambleStartIndexIf N SSBs are associated with a RACH occasion, where N > = 1, for the i-th SSB (i=0, …, N-1) the preamble with preamble index = ra-PreambleStartIndex + i is used for SI request with Msg1 repetition; For N < 1, the preamble with preamble index = ra-PreambleStartIndex is used for SI request with Msg1 repetition.
